id: \bYou seem like a strong Trainer. Would you do this town a favor and check the Solaceon Ruins for us?
en: \bYou seem like a strong Trainer. Would you do this town a favor and check the Solaceon Ruins for us?
it: \bSembri un Allenatore forte. Faresti un favore a questa città e daresti un'occhiata alle Rovine Flemminia per noi?

id: \bIt sounds like someone is disturbing the place. We would deal with it ourselves but we don't raise Pokémon for battle here.
en: \bIt sounds like someone is disturbing the place. We would deal with it ourselves but we don't raise Pokémon for battle here.
it: \bSembra che qualcuno stia disturbando il posto. Ce ne occuperemmo noi, ma qui non alleviamo Pokémon per lottare.

id: \bWe appreciate your help for protecting the ruins.
en: \bWe appreciate your help for protecting the ruins.
it: \bTi siamo grati per aver protetto le rovine.

id: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
en: \bWe were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
it: \bStavamo allevando il tuo Pokémon e, santo cielo, che sorpresa!
\bIl tuo Pokémon aveva con sé un Uovo!

id: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
en: \bWe don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
it: \bNon sappiamo come ci sia finito, ma ce l'aveva il tuo Pokémon.

id: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
en: \bYou have no room for it right now... Come back when you've made room.
it: \bAl momento non hai spazio... Torna quando ne avrai fatto.

id: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
en: \me[Egg get]\PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
it: \me[Egg get]\PN ha ricevuto l'Uovo dal signore della Pensione.

id: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
en: \bI really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
it: \bAllora lo tengo davvero. Lo vuoi questo Uovo, sì?

id: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
en: \bWell all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
it: \bVa bene, allora lo prendo io. Grazie.

id: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
en: \bThat is, I don't think we'll ever find another...
it: \bCioè, non credo che ne troveremo mai un altro...

id: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
en: \bNo, no, I'm sure we'll find another one. I'm definitely sure of it!
it: \bNo, no, sono sicuro che ne troveremo un altro. Ne sono assolutamente certo!

id: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.
en: \bI help take care of the precious Pokémon of trainers.
it: \bAiuto ad accudire i preziosi Pokémon degli Allenatori.

id: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
en: \bAny Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
it: \bSe vuoi far allevare un Pokémon, puoi lasciarlo alle cure di mia moglie.

id: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
en: \bThe two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
it: \bQuei due preferiscono giocare con altri Pokémon piuttosto che tra loro...

id: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.
en: \bThe two don't seem to like each other much.

id: \bThe two seem to get along very well.
en: \bThe two seem to get along very well.

id: \bWant to trade it for my Porygon-Z?
en: \bWant to trade it for my Porygon-Z?

id: \rThere was once nothing here but a road, but people and Pokémon gathered and a town formed.
en: \rThere was once nothing here but a road, but people and Pokémon gathered and a town formed.
it: \rUn tempo qui non c'era altro che una strada, ma persone e Pokémon si sono riuniti ed è nata una città.

id: \bWe tend to stay away from the Ruins. Be careful if you go there.
en: \bWe tend to stay away from the Ruins. Be careful if you go there.
it: \bDi solito stiamo alla larga dalle Rovine. Fai attenzione se ci vai.

id: \bDon't you just hate how long it takes for Eggs to show up? Well now you don't have to!
en: \bDon't you just hate how long it takes for Eggs to show up? Well now you don't have to!
it: \bNon odi anche tu quanto ci mettono a comparire le Uova? Beh, adesso non dovrai più aspettare!

id: \bThat's an Oval Charm. It will increase your chances of finding an Egg.
en: \bThat's an Oval Charm. It will increase your chances of finding an Egg.
it: \bQuello è un Ovamuleto. Aumenta le probabilità di trovare un Uovo.

id: \rJust how long do I need to leave my Pokémon in the Day Care for them to be strong?
en: \rJust how long do I need to leave my Pokémon in the Day Care for them to be strong?
it: \rMa quanto devo lasciare i miei Pokémon alla Pensione perché diventino forti?

id: \rOh I just love writing about the Contests. Especially this one since it is so close to the news press.
en: \rOh I just love writing about the Contests. Especially this one since it is so close to the news press.
it: \rOh, adoro scrivere delle Gare. Soprattutto di questa, visto che è così vicina alla redazione.

id: \bRaising a Pokémon is too much work. I'm glad the Day Care is here.
en: \bRaising a Pokémon is too much work. I'm glad the Day Care is here.
it: \bCrescere un Pokémon è troppo faticoso. Meno male che c'è la Pensione.
